bdd.guideIntro: This test case is written as a scenario. Start from a known state, do one thing, then check what happens.
bdd.guide.given: Before you start, get the app into this state. Tick each line once it is true. If you cannot get there, the result is Blocked, not Fail.
bdd.guide.when: Do exactly this action, and nothing else.
bdd.guide.then: Compare what you see with this sentence. Tick each And line that holds. Text in quotes must appear exactly as written.
bdd.guideVerdict: Everything matches: Pass. Anything is different: Fail, and write down what you saw, with a screenshot.
bdd.editHint: Scenario style: the preconditions are the Given lines. Write each step as When (what the tester does) and Then (what they should see).
ss.editNote: Some steps come from a shared step. Edit the steps in the shared step file (steps/SS-n-….toml) in a working copy; the title and priority can still be saved here.
